![cosmo_banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2dad1f93b8bed44786f04339ba57b27b6e912776.jpeg) [![discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/30ec02a0c24ff230847f55b7c68c7caf8a687a59_0.webp)](https://discord.gg/mfjZyHrWKp) **Cosmopolitan** 是一款专注于扩展食物多样性以及增强原版与各模组之间兼容性的模组。虽然您可以单独游玩此模组，但当搭配兼容模组时，其内容将会变得非常丰富。 ![Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a944c21aa283e4c7250819e28d39b4b256b2a899.png) ![Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62bdd5b6bc77c3cf5b7b9b44e7c3354a6f85e33c_0.webp) ![cosmo-1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4d188cc8950c7bf4e65c3884d44e737b5cdfee6.jpeg) - 野莓、蕨菜、小麦草和桦树汁。所有这些新食材均可通过采集原版方块获得。 - 为苹果、胡萝卜和发光浆果重新设计了食用效果。 ![cosmo-2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e8d149b0b9bef3ebd6869ebbf6f3fc31cf3bbda_0.webp) - 新物品与方块：冰淇淋甜筒、冰淇淋三明治以及新的冰淇淋方块变体 - 流体支持：允许将冰淇淋作为流体处理，并兼容 Create 模组的配方 - 冷冻甜品桶：一款全新方块，用于储存冰淇淋并提供更具沉浸感的合成体验 ![cosmo-3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01d34938c2b4605cd6110b43994000cd793db7e9.jpeg) - 围绕新增食材打造的全新菜肴。 - 四种全新季节性饮品。安装 Serene Seasons 后，在对应的季节饮用将提供有益的状态效果。 ![cosmo-4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3cba49b542d2995aa5b206ca30b97a9165f1171_0.webp) - 为 Undergarden 模组的 Blisterberry 和 Droopfruit 设计了新的食用效果。当玩家处于 Undergarden 维度时，这些效果将提供额外的增益。 - 以类似 Berry Good 模组的风格优化了更多来自其他模组的浆果。 - 一些随机小特性：可再生的史莱姆糖、高级牛奶替代品等……
支持模组列表 - **[JEI](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/jei)** - **[Serene Seasons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons)** - **[Tough As Nails](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tough-as-nails)** - **[Neapolitan](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/neapolitan)** - **[Exquisito](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/exquisito)** - **[Seasonals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seasonals)** - **[Peculiars](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/peculiars)** - **[Respiteful](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/respiteful)** - **[Environmental](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/environmental)** - **[Atmospheric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/atmospheric)** - **[Caverns And Chasms](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/caverns-and-chasms)** - **[Berry Good](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/berry-good)** - **[Quark](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/quark)** - **[Create](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create)** - **[Ars Nouveau](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ars-nouveau)** - **[Habitat](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/habitat)** - **[The Twilight Forest](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest)** - **[The Undergarden](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-undergarden)** - **[Farmers Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-delight)** - **[Brewin And Chewin](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/brewin-and-chewin)** - **[Delightful](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/delightful)** - **[Collectors Reap](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/collectors-reap)** - **[Casualness Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/casualness-delight)** - **[Frycooks Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/frycooks-delight)** - **[Farmers Respite](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/farmers-respite)** - **[Miners Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/miners-delight-plus)** - **[Seed Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/seed-delight)** - **[Sunflower Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/sunflower-delight)** - **[Twilights Flavors Delight](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/twilights-flavors-delight)** - **[Vanilla Cookbook](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vanilla-cookbook)** - **[Kitchen Karrot](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/kitchen-karrot)**
由于该模组目前仍处于早期开发阶段，强烈建议在安装前备份您的世界存档。
